schema: easter-batch-targets-v1 (Bronze strand: no workbook cells, an Arts Award declaration instead)
why: AAE-R1B R4: BRONZE FIRST, fourteen decks, counted against the batch ceiling like any other authored deck. Every row is read from BRONZE_PLAN.json, which is itself derived from SPEC.json's Bronze level with that file's digest recorded. No row was typed from a console print.
cellsNote: AAE-H7. These rows carry no workbook cell: none of the seventeen uncovered BUILD Art cells states a Bronze Part A-D outcome, so claiming one would be a coverage lie and inventing one is worse. planIndex is a Bronze namespace starting at 1001, not a workbook row -- it exists so the driver and the evidence can name a row.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: Where My Art Is Now
outcomes: Record a baseline: one piece made today, and three words for what it does well and one for what it does not.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: What Getting Better Would Look Like
outcomes: Choose one art-form skill to develop, and write the measure that will show it changed.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: Practise The Skill, Session One
outcomes: Work on the chosen skill and record what changed between the first attempt and the last.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: Practise The Skill, And Take One Piece Of Feedback
outcomes: Work on the skill again, take one piece of feedback from a named person, and write it down in their words.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: Make The Change The Feedback Asked For
outcomes: Apply the feedback once, on the piece, and record what it did.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: What Improved, In My Own Words
outcomes: Summarise what was learnt across Part A against the measure set in week one.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: What An Audience Member Actually Does
outcomes: Name what an audience member notices, and why noticing is the evidence.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: The Review Frame, Before The Experience
outcomes: Prepare the review frame: the moment, the craft choice, the effect, and who it was for.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: The Experience, Captured
outcomes: Experience the arts event or exhibition through EVENT_SLOT, review its quality and creative impact, then share that review with another person and record whom, how and the evidence locator.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: Choosing A Practitioner, And Saying Why
outcomes: Choose a real artist, craftsperson or practitioner from the approved pack and say why they were chosen.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: Their Practice, Career, Life And Work
outcomes: Research the chosen real practitioner’s practice, career, life and work, and record where each fact came from.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: Plan The Skills Share
outcomes: Choose an arts skill and plan a short workshop or presentation for a peer, small group or staff member.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: Deliver The Skills Share
outcomes: Deliver the planned arts workshop or presentation and capture what the learner did and the feedback received.

batch.subject: Art
batch.title: Review The Share And Find The Evidence
outcomes: Review how well the skills share went against the plan, and locate the genuine evidence for all four Bronze parts.

routeNote: g26 DERIVES THE PATHWAY FROM THE ROUTE, and it looks for /BUILD_, /BUILD/ or a leading BUILD_. The first naming of this strand -- Art_Teesside/BRONZE_W1-W7_2026-27/BRONZE_Art_W1_... -- contains none of them, so g26 would have returned NOT-APPLICABLE on all fourteen decks: a fail-open on the one gate that reads pupil register. Measured, not guessed: pathway_of returns None for the first form and BUILD for this one. Bronze is a BUILD-band strand and its route now says so.
